Line.zh: He sniffs the ground around him, then looks at you attentively.
Line.en: He sniffs the ground around him, then looks at you attentively.
Line.ja: He sniffs the ground around him, then looks at you attentively.

name.zh:
He looks back at his burrow, as if telling you something.

From what you can see past him, it looks surprisingly cozy.

You understand. This is his home.

And somehow... he is his home.

name.zh:
He looks at his wares, then at you.

You understand: the more he trusts you, the better the things he'll offer.

He sniffs at them, then looks at you again.

He likes bugs, mice, all kinds of acorns, and edible roots.

He doesn't seem to trust you enough to help you.
